2618.title: Thread details omit current rate-limit state
2618.rootCauseOneLine: Thread response builders never query or expose the persisted rate-limit event, and the single-thread contract also omits activity.
2618.proposedFix: Add full rate-limit state to list and show contracts through a targeted latest-event query, and reuse the activity builder for show.
2618.caveats: The JSON event log can return the event, but it does not provide a direct current-state read.
